name: astra-db
description: First-class Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) toolkit: data modeling for Collections and Tables, Astra CLI workflows, application architecture patterns, and 1,600+ doc-synced Data API code snippets for Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, and Go — plus live database tools via the Astra DB MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Build on Astra DB with expert data modeling, CLI workflows, and 1,600+ doc-synced Data API snippets.
interface.longDescription: Agent-native tooling for Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) and HCD. The astra-toolkit skill provides progressive-disclosure instructions for the Astra CLI, application architecture patterns, data modeling for Collections and Tables, and roughly 340 documentation-derived Data API snippets per client language (Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, Go) — self-sufficient, no web lookups needed. Invoke $astra-setup to connect a project, $astra-doctor to diagnose it, $astra-data-model-review to audit a data model, and the $astra-reviewer, $astra-data-modeler, and $astra-migration-helper persona skills for expert help. An optional bundled MCP server adds live database operations when ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN and ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT are set.
defaultPrompt: Create an Astra DB collection with vector search and show me idiomatic Python code to query it
Review my project's Astra DB data model
Help me choose between Collections and Tables for my workload
